task.title: Implement SteamLocomotiveEntity, Item, and InputPayload
task.description:
Implement the server and shared logic for the new 2-block long steam locomotive:

1. `SteamLocomotiveInputPayload.java`:
- A CustomPacketPayload for sending throttle input and reverser toggle from client to server.
- Record fields: `float throttle` (-1.0F to 1.0F), `boolean reverser` (false = forward, true = reverse).
- Identifier: `minecart_chain:steam_locomotive_input`.
- Implement `CustomPacketPayload.Type<SteamLocomotiveInputPayload> TYPE = new CustomPacketPayload.Type<>(MinecartChainMod.id("steam_locomotive_input"))` and `StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, SteamLocomotiveInputPayload> CODEC` (or FriendlyByteBuf).

2. `SteamLocomotiveEntity.java`:
- Extends `AbstractMinecart`.
- Constructor: `(EntityType<? extends SteamLocomotiveEntity>, Level)`.
- Dimensions: length 2 blocks. Sized approx (0.98F, 1.2F) or 2.0F length if applicable.
- SynchedEntityData accessors:
  - `THROTTLE` (float, -1.0F to 1.0F)
  - `REVERSER` (boolean, false = forward, true = reverse)
  - `FUEL_TICKS` (int)
  - `WATER_TICKS` (int)
- Provide getters/setters: `getThrottle()`, `setThrottle(float)`, `isReverser()`, `setReverser(boolean)`.
- When ridden by a passenger (player):
  - In `tick()`:
    - If throttle > 0: Locomotive drives forward (or reverse if reverser is active) along the rails!
      Calculate track direction: use `MinecartTrainLogic.engineDirection(this)` or rail direction.
      Speed scales with throttle: `pushSpeed = MAX_SPEED * throttle`.
      Apply acceleration/assist via `MinecartTrainLogic` or horizontal movement along track.
      Guide coupled wagons via `MinecartTrainLogic.guidePoweredTrain` or chain links.
      Spawn steam/smoke particles at the chimney at front:
      Position of chimney is at the front (~0.8 blocks forward from center, +1.4 blocks high).
      Spawn `ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE` or `ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE` depending on throttle intensity!
    - If throttle == 0: Idle/coasting (natural friction).
    - If throttle < 0: Active braking! Apply braking deceleration proportional to `|throttle|`, stopping the locomotive and chained wagons.
    - Sound: occasionally play steam hiss or chuff sounds.
- Passenger handling:
  - `isRideable()` returns true.
  - `interact(Player player, InteractionHand hand, Vec3 hitLocation)`:
    - If player is sneak-interacting with fuel (coal/water), handle fuel/water replenishment or allow GUI.
    - If not sneaking and no passenger, `player.startRiding(this)`. Return SUCCESS.
  - `positionRider(Entity passenger, Entity.MoveFunction moveFunction)`:
    - Position passenger at the REAR CAB of the 2-block locomotive!
    - Calculate rear offset based on locomotive yaw (`getYRot()`):
      Yaw determines forward direction. Rider sits at -0.65 blocks backwards along facing direction, and +0.35 Y elevation inside the cab.
      Call `moveFunction.accept(passenger, riderX, riderY, riderZ)`.
  - Override `getDismountLocationForPassenger(LivingEntity passenger)` to safely dismount to the side.
  - Override `getDropItem()` -> returns `MinecartChainMod.STEAM_LOCOMOTIVE_ITEM`.
  - Override `getPickResult()` -> returns `new ItemStack(MinecartChainMod.STEAM_LOCOMOTIVE_ITEM)`.
  - Save/load throttle, reverser, fuel, water in `addAdditionalSaveData(ValueOutput)` and `readAdditionalSaveData(ValueInput)`.

3. `SteamLocomotiveItem.java`:
- Extends `Item`.
- `useOn(UseOnContext context)`:
  - Checks if clicked block is rails (`BlockTags.RAILS`).
  - Spawns `SteamLocomotiveEntity` on the rails in `serverLevel`.
  - Snaps initial locomotive yaw to rail direction.
  - Plays placement sound, consumes item if not creative.

Ensure code strictly follows Minecraft 26.3 Mojmap API, clean style, no compile warnings.

task.title: Implement SteamLocomotiveModel, Renderer, RenderState, and JSONs
task.description:
Implement the client model, render state, entity renderer, and item model for the new 2-block long steam locomotive in Minecraft 26.3:

1. `SteamLocomotiveRenderState.java`:
- Extends `MinecartRenderState` (or `EntityRenderState`).
- Fields:
  - `float throttle`
  - `boolean reverser`
  - `float wheelRotation`
  - `float pitch`
  - `float yaw`
  - `float roll`
  - `double speed`
- Provide getters and setters.

2. `SteamLocomotiveModel.java`:
- Extends `EntityModel<SteamLocomotiveRenderState>`.
- The locomotive must look authentically like a steam locomotive and be 2 BLOCKS LONG (~32 pixels/units along length X, ~14 units wide along Z, ~16-20 units high along Y).
- Parts to build in `createBodyLayer()` using `LayerDefinition` (texture size 128x128 or 256x128):
  - Undercarriage / Chassis: 32 units long (-16 to +16), 14 units wide, with front buffer beam / cowcatcher.
  - Boiler: Long cylindrical body covering front 20 units (-16 to +4), with rounded/faceted appearance.
  - Smokebox & front door: Front face (-16) with central round door and headlight/lamp.
  - Chimney / Smokestack: Located at front (around x = -11), vertical pipe (height ~6 units) with top lip/rim.
  - Steam Dome & Sand Dome: Along the top of boiler (e.g. x = -5, x = 0).
  - Driver Cab: Located at rear (+4 to +16):
    - Side walls (left and right) with cut-out windows.
    - Curved/sloped cab roof covering the top (+4 to +16).
    - Open back entrance where driver steps in.
    - Cab interior: Backhead boiler face with simulated firebox glow/door and steam gauges, driver footplate / bench.
  - Wheels & Rods:
    - 6 driving wheels (3 pairs: front, center, rear) along each side.
    - Side coupling rods connecting the wheels.
- `setupAnim(SteamLocomotiveRenderState state)`:
  - Animate wheels and coupling rods rotating based on `state.wheelRotation`.

3. `SteamLocomotiveRenderer.java`:
- Extends `EntityRenderer<SteamLocomotiveEntity, SteamLocomotiveRenderState>`.
- Registered for `MinecartChainMod.STEAM_LOCOMOTIVE_ENTITY`.
- Texture: `Identifier.fromNamespaceAndPath(MinecartChainMod.MOD_ID, "textures/entity/steam_locomotive.png")`.
- `extractRenderState(SteamLocomotiveEntity entity, SteamLocomotiveRenderState state, float partialTick)`:
  - Populates throttle, reverser, yaw, pitch, roll.
  - Accumulates wheel rotation based on movement distance: `state.wheelRotation = (float) (entity.tickCount * 0.2 + partialTick * 0.2 * entity.getDeltaMovement().length() * 20.0)`.
- `submit(SteamLocomotiveRenderState state, PoseStack poseStack, SubmitNodeCollector collector, CameraRenderState cameraState)`:
  - Note 26.3 API: `poseStack.rotateDegrees(Axis.YP, 180.0F - state.yaw)` (or state.yRot).
  - `collector.submitModel(this.model, state, poseStack, TEXTURE, state.lightCoords, OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY, state.outlineColor);` (7 arguments in 26.3, no trailing null).

4. Item JSONs:
- `src/main/resources/assets/minecart_chain/items/steam_locomotive.json`:
```json
{
  "model": {
    "type": "minecraft:model",
    "model": "minecart_chain:item/steam_locomotive"
  }
}
```
- `src/main/resources/assets/minecart_chain/models/item/steam_locomotive.json`:
```json
{
  "parent": "minecraft:item/generated",
  "textures": {
    "layer0": "minecart_chain:item/steam_locomotive"
  }
}
```

Follow 26.3 Mojmap API strictly. Compile-clean code.

task.title: Fix Locomotive Braking, Wheel Rotation tracking, and Coupler Lever logic
task.description:
Fix the physics, braking, wheel animation tracking, and add wagon coupler lever logic to SteamLocomotiveEntity:

1. Braking Fix ("pomimo brake lokomotywa jedzie"):
- When `throttle < 0.0F` (brake applied):
  - Forcefully decelerate: `applyBrake(serverLevel, Math.abs(throttle))` must strongly damp horizontal velocity.
  - If `horizontalDistanceSqr() < 0.008` (or speed is low) or `throttle <= -0.7F`, immediately set horizontal movement to ZERO (`this.setDeltaMovement(0, this.getDeltaMovement().y, 0)`).
  - Also call `MinecartTrainLogic.applyTrainBrake(this)` to brake all chained follower wagons.
  - In `tick()`, if `throttle < 0.0F` and the train is at or near zero speed, enforce `this.setDeltaMovement(0, this.getDeltaMovement().y, 0)` so the locomotive DOES NOT drift, roll, or get accelerated by powered rails while brake is applied!
  - Override `activateMinecart(ServerLevel level, int x, int y, int z, boolean powered)`: do NOT let powered rails push the locomotive if `this.getThrottle() < 0.0F`.

2. Wheel Rotation Tracking ("animacja kół ma sie zatrzymywac gdy lokomotywa stoi"):
- Maintain internal `wheelRotation` and `prevWheelRotation` (or SynchedEntityData / getter).
- In `tick()`:
  - Check horizontal speed: `double hSpeed = this.getDeltaMovement().horizontalDistance();`
  - Only update `wheelRotation` when `hSpeed > 0.001D`:
    `float rotDelta = (float) ((this.isReverser() ? -1.0F : 1.0F) * (hSpeed / 0.22D));`
    `this.prevWheelRotation = this.wheelRotation;`
    `this.wheelRotation += rotDelta;`
  - When stopped (`hSpeed <= 0.001D`), `wheelRotation` does NOT advance!
- Add public method:
  `public float getWheelRotation(final float partialTick) { return Mth.lerp(partialTick, this.prevWheelRotation, this.wheelRotation); }`

3. Coupler Lever Logic ("dodaj dzwignie do podłączenia wagonu"):
- Add SynchedEntityData boolean `COUPLER_ENGAGED` (with getter `isCouplerEngaged()` / setter).
- Add method `public void toggleCoupler(final ServerLevel level)`:
  - If `isCouplerEngaged()` or `minecartChain$linkCount() > 0`:
    - Uncouple: clear links (`minecartChain$clearLinks()`), set `COUPLER_ENGAGED` to false.
    - Play `SoundEvents.CHAIN_BREAK`.
  - Else:
    - Search for nearest `AbstractMinecart` behind the locomotive along the track within 2.5 blocks.
    - If found and not already linked: link them (`minecartChain$addLink(cart.getUUID())`, and cart links to locomotive).
    - Set `COUPLER_ENGAGED` to true.
    - Play `SoundEvents.CHAIN_PLACE`.
- Update `SteamLocomotiveInputPayload`:
  - Add `boolean toggleCoupler` flag (or `(float throttle, boolean reverser, boolean toggleCoupler)`).
  - Decode/encode `toggleCoupler`.
- In `SteamLocomotiveEntity`, add `public void handleDriverInput(final float throttle, final boolean reverser, final boolean toggleCoupler)` that updates throttle, reverser, and calls `toggleCoupler(serverLevel)` if `toggleCoupler` is true.

Ensure clean compile for Minecraft 26.3 Mojmap.

task.title: Fix Rail Height, Wheel Model/Animation, and Coupler Lever
task.description:
Fix the locomotive height on rails, wheel visual model & animation, and render the cab coupler lever:

1. Height on Rails ("lokomotywa powinna stac na kolach na kolach, teraz jest za nisko"):
- Right now in `SteamLocomotiveRenderer.submit()`, the model is placed at Y=0 without translation, causing the wheels to sink deep into the gravel/ground under the rails!
- Fix: In `SteamLocomotiveRenderer.submit()`, add a vertical translation BEFORE rotating/scaling:
  `poseStack.translate(0.0F, 0.35F, 0.0F);` (or calculate exact offset so the bottom of the wheels rests EXACTLY on top of the rails, matching vanilla minecart rail height of ~0.375F / 6 pixels above block base).
- Also check the wheel positioning in `SteamLocomotiveModel.java`:
  Make sure the bottom of the wheels lines up with the bottom of the model's contact point with the rails.

2. Wheel Model & Animation Stop ("animacja kół ma sie zatrzymywac gdy lokomotywa stoi"):
- In `SteamLocomotiveRenderer.extractRenderState()`:
  - DO NOT do `entity.tickCount * 0.2`! That caused wheels to spin continuously while stopped!
  - Instead: `state.wheelRotation = entity.getWheelRotation(partialTick);`
- In `SteamLocomotiveModel.java`:
  - Enhance wheel geometry so it actually looks round like a train wheel (e.g. octagonal crossed boxes 6x4 and 4x6, or 7x5 and 5x7 with 1.0 thickness) instead of a simple square that looks like slanted wedges when turning!
  - Position wheels at track rail gauge: z = -6.0F and z = +6.0F (the exact center line of Minecraft standard rails!).
  - Connect coupling rods cleanly to the wheel crank pins at z = -7.0F and z = +7.0F.
  - When `state.wheelRotation` is constant (stopped), wheels and rods remain stationary.

3. Coupler Lever in Cab ("dodaj dzwignie do podłączenia wagonu"):
- Add `public boolean couplerEngaged;` to `SteamLocomotiveRenderState`.
- Extract `state.couplerEngaged = entity.isCouplerEngaged();` in `SteamLocomotiveRenderer`.
- In `SteamLocomotiveModel.java`:
  - In `createBodyLayer()`: add a coupler lever model part inside the cab (e.g. on the backhead/control stand or rear wall, child "coupler_lever").
  - The lever should have a base and a handle (e.g. 1x4x1 handle with red or brass knob).
  - In `setupAnim()`: animate the lever angle based on `state.couplerEngaged` (e.g. tilted forward when disengaged, pulled back when engaged/coupled!).

Ensure clean compile for Minecraft 26.3 Mojmap.
